intent: Signal store for routines. Public API: RoutinesStore.state: Signal<ViewState>; RoutinesStore.steps: Signal<WorkoutStep[]>; RoutinesStore.phases: Signal<PhaseProgress[]>; RoutinesStore.selectedStepId: Signal<string | null>; RoutinesStore.selectedStep: Signal<WorkoutStep | null>; RoutinesStore.load(routineId: string): void; RoutinesStore.selectStep(stepId: string): void; RoutinesStore.completeSelected(): void; RoutinesStore.advance(): void. load fetches steps+phases (state loading/empty/error/success) and selects first incomplete step; completeSelected() calls completeStep then shows ToastStore.show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string success; advance() calls advancePhase and shows ToastStore.show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string info for phase transition. Consumes RoutinesApi.getSteps(routineId: string): Observable<WorkoutStep[]>; RoutinesApi.getPhases(routineId: string): Observable<PhaseProgress[]>; RoutinesApi.completeStep(routineId: string, stepId: string): Observable<WorkoutStep>; RoutinesApi.advancePhase(routineId: string): Observable<PhaseProgress[]>.
